Amelia —

Thanks for the clear brief; appreciate the traffic numbers. High-level summary up front, then a short proposed packaging: 

Quick guidance on GPUs for your mix:
- H100 (80GB): best for the 70B personalization models — significantly more KV cache + memory headroom; single-GPU latency and batch performance are superior for long-context generations. For medium/large models we estimate ~1.8-2.1x throughput vs A100 on our inference stack. Higher list price but better perf/latency for fewer GPUs.
- A100 (40GB): solid general-purpose option; tight on memory for 70B without quantization — usually requires 2x sharding or model distillation. Perf is ~0.5-0.6x of H100 for your 70B use case but often more cost-effective if you can split the model.
- L40S (48GB): inference-focused, lower cost per hour, good perf on smaller models (7B/13B). For 70B it's marginal — possible with aggressive quantization (4-bit) and model surgery but not recommended for personalization at p95<200ms. Perf/$ is attractive for embedding and routing workloads.

Sizing recommendation (initial commit to hit steady-state 50 concurrent, absorb spikes to 180 with burst):
- Baseline reserved pool: 6 x H100 (dedicated) — targets steady-state p95 ~160-190ms for typical 70B config with our optimized kernels. This covers 50 concurrent with room for KV cache and headroom.
- Mixed fallback/burst pool: 8 x L40S (shared burst capacity) to handle peak short-term spikes; useful for routing/7B tasks to remove load from H100s.
- Alternative lower-cost baseline: 10 x A100 (reserved) with model-sharding — higher operational complexity, slightly higher p95 (180–240ms) for personalization flows.

Packaging & discounts (ballpark):
- Monthly reserved: 10% off retail, flexible month-to-month but limited capacity guarantees.
- 12-month annual commit: 30% off retail + SLA (99.9% uptime for dedicated pool) + 50% on first-month onboarding credits.
- Burst buffer: optional 30% discount on spot/L40S time if used as burst-only; burst does not count toward committed headroom for SLA.

SLA & throughput guarantees:
- We can guarantee capacity-based throughput and an SLO on p95 latency for quoted model builds when on a 12-month commit (we run canaries and pinned model versions). SLA-level escalation and dedicated oncall included in enterprise package.

I've attached a short pricing sketch and an SLA draft. If you want, I can loop in pricing and product ops to turn this into a formal quote.

Available for a 30-min call this afternoon to walk through tradeoffs.

Best,
Marcus Lin
